crossRefs.note: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself the pillar which is in the king’s valley, for he said…
His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.
“I will rise up against them,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and son and son’s…
Yahweh says, “Record this man as childless, a man who will not prosper in his days; for no more will a man of his…
After this, Absalom the son of David had a beautiful sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

translations.web: Three sons were born to Absalom, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar. She was a woman with a beautiful face.
translations.bsb: Three sons were born to Absalom, and a daughter named Tamar, who was a beautiful woman.
translations.kjv: And unto Absalom there were born three sons, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar: she was a woman of a fair countenance.
translations.asv: And unto Absalom there were born three sons, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar: she was a woman of a fair countenance.
